tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Describe Seatac Connection: private, pre-booked rides between Seatac Airport and the Seattle area, plus hourly charters. Returns the service area, vehicle types with passenger and bag capacity, booking requirements, and the cancellation and refund policy. Fares are quoted per trip; use quote_ride fo

tools.name: quote_ride
tools.description: Get the live fare for a specific Seatac Connection ride, per eligible vehicle, priced exactly as seatac.co checkout prices it. Each vehicle includes a booking_url where the customer reviews and pays. Rate limited; reuse a quote instead of re-requesting it.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Create a prefilled seatac.co reservation link for the customer to open. They review the trip, enter contact details, and pay on seatac.co. Nothing is booked or charged by this tool.

tools.name: find_cruise_sailings
tools.description: Look up Seattle cruise sailings from the Port of Seattle schedule (2026 season and the preliminary 2027 season): which pier and terminal a ship uses on a date, and which ships sail on a day.
